name: window-resizer
title: Window Resizer
description: Automate window resizing and alignment for multi-monitor setups. Set custom favorite dimensions for each display size (14", 15", 17", 24", 27", 32", etc.), auto-center windows while respecting Stage Manager, and configure application-specific sizes and exclusions.
author: yash_srivastava

commands.name: apply-favorite-size
commands.title: Apply Favorite Size
commands.description: Resizes the active window to the favorite size for the current display

commands.name: resize-window
commands.title: Resize Window
commands.description: Resize focused window to preset or custom pixel-perfect dimensions

commands.name: get-current-size
commands.title: Get Current Size
commands.description: Gets the current active window dimensions

commands.name: auto-resize
commands.title: Auto-Resize Background Daemon
commands.description: Automatically resizes windows in the background based on active screen

commands.name: exclude-current-app
commands.title: Exclude Current Application
commands.description: Excludes the currently active application from auto-resize and centering

preferences.name: enableAutoResize
preferences.title: Enable Auto-Resize
preferences.label: Auto-resize active windows when they shift displays or open
preferences.description: Periodically checks active window position and resizes it to the display's favorite size if it doesn't match

preferences.name: enableAutoCenter
preferences.title: Enable Auto-Center
preferences.label: Automatically center resized/moved windows on the active display
preferences.description: When checked, windows are centered when resized. Otherwise, they keep their relative top-left position (clamped to screen).

preferences.name: defaultDisplaySizes
preferences.title: Default Sizes mapping
preferences.description: Comma-separated monitor diagonal (inches) to custom default resolution (e.g. 14:1070x916, 24:1238x988, 27:1920x1080)

preferences.name: excludedApps
preferences.title: Excluded Applications
preferences.description: Comma-separated list of application names to exclude from resize and center (e.g., Spotify, Zoom)

preferences.name: appSpecificSizes
preferences.title: App-Specific Favorite Sizes
preferences.description: Comma-separated favorite sizes for specific apps (e.g. Spotify:24:1000x800, Safari:14:900x700)

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
